channels.G: Ownership multiplied by the capped-normal-angle threshold predicate BEFORE MSAA resolve. Thresholds: 0.01 and 0.1 degrees in the two readouts.

channels.A: 0.75+0.20*(clamped display-transformed beauty luminance multiplied by original alpha). Data marker and live material/lighting/exposure/opacity dependency, not a metric. Pure native/background alpha255 is excluded; MSAA material boundaries remain uncertain.

counterfactual: Same original surface-gradient operator and 0.26 cap applied to psH and psH-finalAddedHeight in the same fragment; the difference is an in-shader numerical counterfactual.
limitations: Engineering thresholds are not physiological measurements or human visibility thresholds.
